vulg: Paulus apostolus Iesu Christi per voluntatem Dei et Timotheus frater ecclesiae Dei quae est Corinthi cum sanctis omnibus qui sunt in universa Achaia
clem: Paulus, Apostolus Jesu Christi per voluntatem Dei, et Timotheus frater, ecclesi Dei, qu est Corinthi cum omnibus sanctis, qui sunt in universa Achaia.
tr: παυλος αποστολος ιησου χριστου δια θεληματος θεου και τιμοθεος ο αδελφος τη εκκλησια του θεου τη ουση εν κορινθω συν τοις αγιοις πασιν τοις ουσιν εν ολη τη αχαια
kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

vulg: gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Iesu Christi Pater misericordiarum et Deus totius consolationis
clem: Benedictus Deus et Pater Domini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater misericordiarum, et Deus totius consolationis,
tr: ευλογητος ο θεος και πατηρ του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου ο πατηρ των οικτιρμων και θεος πασης παρακλησεως
kjv: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

vulg: qui consolatur nos in omni tribulatione nostra ut possimus et ipsi consolari eos qui in omni pressura sunt per exhortationem qua exhortamur et ipsi a Deo
clem: qui consolatur nos in omni tribulatione nostra: ut possimus et ipsi consolari eos qui in omni pressura sunt, per exhortationem, qua exhortamur et ipsi a Deo.
tr: ο παρακαλων ημας επι παση τη θλιψει ημων εις το δυνασθαι ημας παρακαλειν τους εν παση θλιψει δια της παρακλησεως ης παρακαλουμεθα αυτοι υπο του θεου
kjv: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

vulg: quoniam sicut abundant passiones Christi in nobis ita et per Christum abundat consolatio nostra
clem: Quoniam sicut abundant passiones Christi in nobis: ita et per Christum abundat consolatio nostra.
tr: οτι καθως περισσευει τα παθηματα του χριστου εις ημας ουτως δια χριστου περισσευει και η παρακλησις ημων
kjv: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

vulg: sive autem tribulamur pro vestra exhortatione et salute sive exhortamur pro vestra exhortatione quae operatur in tolerantia earundem passionum quas et nos patimur
clem: Sive autem tribulamur pro vestra exhortatione et salute, sive consolamur pro vestra consolatione, sive exhortamur pro vestra exhortatione et salute, qu operatur tolerantiam earumdem passionum, quas et nos patimur:
tr: ειτε δε θλιβομεθα υπερ της υμων παρακλησεως και σωτηριας της ενεργουμενης εν υπομονη των αυτων παθηματων ων και ημεις πασχομεν ειτε παρακαλουμεθα υπερ της υμων παρακλησεως και σωτηριας και η ελπις ημων βεβαια υπερ υμων
kjv: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

vulg: et spes nostra firma pro vobis scientes quoniam sicut socii passionum estis sic eritis et consolationis
clem: ut spes nostra firma sit pro vobis: scientes quod sicut socii passionum estis, sic eritis et consolationis.
tr: ειδοτες οτι ωσπερ κοινωνοι εστε των παθηματων ουτως και της παρακλησεως
kjv: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

vulg: non enim volumus ignorare vos fratres de tribulatione nostra quae facta est in Asia quoniam supra modum gravati sumus supra virtutem ita ut taederet nos etiam vivere
clem: Non enim volumus ignorare vos, fratres, de tribulatione nostra, qu facta est in Asia, quoniam supra modum gravati sumus supra virtutem, ita ut tderet nos etiam vivere.
tr: ου γαρ θελομεν υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι υπερ της θλιψεως ημων της γενομενης ημιν εν τη ασια οτι καθ υπερβολην εβαρηθημεν υπερ δυναμιν ωστε εξαπορηθηναι ημας και του ζην
kjv: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

vulg: sed ipsi in nobis ipsis responsum mortis habuimus ut non simus fidentes in nobis sed in Deo qui suscitat mortuos
clem: Sed ipsi in nobismetipsis responsum mortis habuimus, ut non simus fidentes in mortuos, sed in Deo, qui suscitat mortuos:
tr: αλλα αυτοι εν εαυτοις το αποκριμα του θανατου εσχηκαμεν ινα μη πεποιθοτες ωμεν εφ εαυτοις αλλ επι τω θεω τω εγειροντι τους νεκρους
kjv: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

vulg: qui de tantis periculis eripuit nos et eruet in quem speramus quoniam et adhuc eripiet
clem: qui de tantis periculis nos eripuit, et eruit: in quem speramus quoniam et adhuc eripiet,
tr: ος εκ τηλικουτου θανατου ερρυσατο ημας και ρυεται εις ον ηλπικαμεν οτι και ετι ρυσεται
kjv: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

vulg: adiuvantibus et vobis in oratione pro nobis ut ex multis personis eius quae in nobis est donationis per multos gratiae agantur pro nobis
clem: adjuvantibus et vobis in oratione pro nobis: ut ex multorum personis, ejus qu in nobis est donationis, per multos grati agantur pro nobis.
tr: συνυπουργουντων και υμων υπερ ημων τη δεησει ινα εκ πολλων προσωπων το εις ημας χαρισμα δια πολλων ευχαριστηθη υπερ ημων
kjv: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

vulg: nam gloria nostra haec est testimonium conscientiae nostrae quod in simplicitate et sinceritate Dei et non in sapientia carnali sed in gratia Dei conversati sumus in mundo abundantius autem ad vos
clem: Nam gloria nostra hc est: testimonium conscienti nostr, quod in simplicitate cordis et sinceritate Dei, et non in sapientia carnali, sed in gratia Dei, conversati sumus in hoc mundo: abundantius autem ad vos.
tr: η γαρ καυχησις ημων αυτη εστιν το μαρτυριον της συνειδησεως ημων οτι εν απλοτητι και ειλικρινεια θεου ουκ εν σοφια σαρκικη αλλ εν χαριτι θεου ανεστραφημεν εν τω κοσμω περισσοτερως δε προς υμας
kjv: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

vulg: non enim alia scribimus vobis quam quae legistis et cognoscitis spero autem quod usque in finem cognoscetis
clem: Non enim alia scribimus vobis, quam qu legistis, et cognovistis. Spero autem quod usque in finem cognoscetis,
tr: ου γαρ αλλα γραφομεν υμιν αλλ η α αναγινωσκετε η και επιγινωσκετε ελπιζω δε οτι και εως τελους επιγνωσεσθε
kjv: For we write none other things unto you, that what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

vulg: sicut et cognovistis nos ex parte quia gloria vestra sumus sicut et vos nostra in die Domini nostri Iesu Christi
clem: sicut et cognovistis nos ex parte, quod gloria vestra sumus, sicut et vos nostra, in die Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
tr: καθως και επεγνωτε ημας απο μερους οτι καυχημα υμων εσμεν καθαπερ και υμεις ημων εν τη ημερα του κυριου ιησου
kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.

vulg: et hac confidentia volui prius venire ad vos ut secundam gratiam haberetis
clem: Et hac confidentia volui prius venire ad vos, ut secundum gratiam haberetis:
tr: και ταυτη τη πεποιθησει εβουλομην προς υμας ελθειν προτερον ινα δευτεραν χαριν εχητε
kjv: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

vulg: et per vos transire in Macedoniam et iterum a Macedonia venire ad vos et a vobis deduci in Iudaeam
clem: et per vos transire in Macedoniam, et iterum a Macedonia venire ad vos, et a vobis deduci in Judam.
tr: και δι υμων διελθειν εις μακεδονιαν και παλιν απο μακεδονιας ελθειν προς υμας και υφ υμων προπεμφθηναι εις την ιουδαιαν
kjv: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

vulg: cum hoc ergo voluissem numquid levitate usus sum aut quae cogito secundum carnem cogito ut sit apud me est et non
clem: Cum ergo hoc voluissem, numquid levitate usus sum? aut qu cogito, secundum carnem cogito, ut sit apud me Est et Non?
tr: τουτο ουν βουλευομενος μη τι αρα τη ελαφρια εχρησαμην η α βουλευομαι κατα σαρκα βουλευομαι ινα η παρ εμοι το ναι ναι και το ου ου
kjv: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

vulg: fidelis autem Deus quia sermo noster qui fit apud vos non est in illo est et non
clem: Fidelis autem Deus, quia sermo noster, qui fuit apud vos, non est in illo Est et Non.
tr: πιστος δε ο θεος οτι ο λογος ημων ο προς υμας ουκ εγενετο ναι και ου
kjv: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

vulg: Dei enim Filius Iesus Christus qui in vobis per nos praedicatus est per me et Silvanum et Timotheum non fuit est et non sed est in illo fuit
clem: Dei enim Filius Jesus Christus, qui in vobis per nos prdicatus est, per me, et Silvanum, et Timotheum, non fuit Est et Non, sed Est in illo fuit.
tr: ο γαρ του θεου υιος ιησους χριστος ο εν υμιν δι ημων κηρυχθεις δι εμου και σιλουανου και τιμοθεου ουκ εγενετο ναι και ου αλλα ναι εν αυτω γεγονεν
kjv: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

vulg: quotquot enim promissiones Dei sunt in illo est ideo et per ipsum amen Deo ad gloriam nostram
clem: Quotquot enim promissiones Dei sunt, in illo Est: ideo et per ipsum Amen Deo ad gloriam nostram.
tr: οσαι γαρ επαγγελιαι θεου εν αυτω το ναι και εν αυτω το αμην τω θεω προς δοξαν δι ημων
kjv: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

vulg: qui autem confirmat nos vobiscum in Christum et qui unxit nos Deus
clem: Qui autem confirmat nos vobiscum in Christo, et qui unxit nos Deus:
tr: ο δε βεβαιων ημας συν υμιν εις χριστον και χρισας ημας θεος
kjv: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

vulg: et qui signavit nos et dedit pignus Spiritus in cordibus nostris
clem: qui et signavit nos, et dedit pignus Spiritus in cordibus nostris.
tr: ο και σφραγισαμενος ημας και δους τον αρραβωνα του πνευματος εν ταις καρδιαις ημων
kjv: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

vulg: ego autem testem Deum invoco in animam meam quod parcens vobis non veni ultra Corinthum
clem: Ego autem testem Deum invoco in animam meam, quod parcens vobis, non veni ultra Corinthum:
tr: εγω δε μαρτυρα τον θεον επικαλουμαι επι την εμην ψυχην οτι φειδομενος υμων ουκετι ηλθον εις κορινθον
kjv: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

vulg: non quia dominamur fidei vestrae sed adiutores sumus gaudii vestri nam fide stetistis
clem: non quia dominamur fidei vest, sed adjutores sumus gaudii vestri: nam fide statis.
tr: ουχ οτι κυριευομεν υμων της πιστεως αλλα συνεργοι εσμεν της χαρας υμων τη γαρ πιστει εστηκατε
kjv: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

vulg: statui autem hoc ipse apud me ne iterum in tristitia venirem ad vos
clem: Statui autem hoc ipsum apud me, ne iterum in tristitia venirem ad vos.
tr: εκρινα δε εμαυτω τουτο το μη παλιν ελθειν εν λυπη προς υμας
kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

vulg: si enim ego contristo vos et quis est qui me laetificet nisi qui contristatur ex me
clem: Si enim ego contristo vos: et quis est, qui me ltificet, nisi qui contristatur ex me?
tr: ει γαρ εγω λυπω υμας και τις εστιν ο ευφραινων με ει μη ο λυπουμενος εξ εμου
kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

vulg: et hoc ipsum scripsi ut non cum venero tristitiam super tristitiam habeam de quibus oportuerat me gaudere confidens in omnibus vobis quia meum gaudium omnium vestrum est
clem: Et hoc ipsum scripsi vobis, ut non cum venero, tristitiam super tristitiam habeam, de quibus oportuerat me gaudere: confidens in omnibus vobis, quia meum gaudium, omnium vestrum est.
tr: και εγραψα υμιν τουτο αυτο ινα μη ελθων λυπην εχω αφ ων εδει με χαιρειν πεποιθως επι παντας υμας οτι η εμη χαρα παντων υμων εστιν
kjv: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

vulg: nam ex multa tribulatione et angustia cordis scripsi vobis per multas lacrimas non ut contristemini sed ut sciatis quam caritatem habeo abundantius in vobis
clem: Nam ex multa tribulatione et angustia cordis scripsi vobis per multas lacrimas: non ut contristemini, sed ut sciatis, quam caritatem habeam abundantius in vobis.
tr: εκ γαρ πολλης θλιψεως και συνοχης καρδιας εγραψα υμιν δια πολλων δακρυων ουχ ινα λυπηθητε αλλα την αγαπην ινα γνωτε ην εχω περισσοτερως εις υμας
kjv: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

vulg: si quis autem contristavit non me contristavit sed ex parte ut non onerem omnes vos
clem: Si quis autem contristavit, non me contristavit: sed ex parte, ut non onerem omnes vos.
tr: ει δε τις λελυπηκεν ουκ εμε λελυπηκεν αλλ απο μερους ινα μη επιβαρω παντας υμας
kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

vulg: sufficit illi qui eiusmodi est obiurgatio haec quae fit a pluribus
clem: Sufficit illi, qui ejusmodi est, objurgatio hc, qu fit a pluribus:
tr: ικανον τω τοιουτω η επιτιμια αυτη η υπο των πλειονων
kjv: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

vulg: ita ut e contra magis donetis et consolemini ne forte abundantiori tristitia absorbeatur qui eiusmodi est
clem: ita ut e contrario magis donetis, et consolemini, ne forte abundantiori tristitia absorbeatur qui ejusmodi est.
tr: ωστε τουναντιον μαλλον υμας χαρισασθαι και παρακαλεσαι μηπως τη περισσοτερα λυπη καταποθη ο τοιουτος
kjv: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

vulg: propter quod obsecro vos ut confirmetis in illum caritatem
clem: Propter quod obsecro vos, ut confirmetis in illum caritatem.
tr: διο παρακαλω υμας κυρωσαι εις αυτον αγαπην
kjv: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

vulg: ideo enim et scripsi ut cognoscam experimentum vestrum an in omnibus oboedientes sitis
clem: Ideo enim et scripsi, ut cognoscam experimentum vestrum, an in omnibus obedientes sitis.
tr: εις τουτο γαρ και εγραψα ινα γνω την δοκιμην υμων ει εις παντα υπηκοοι εστε
kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

vulg: cui autem aliquid donatis et ego nam et ego quod donavi si quid donavi propter vos in persona Christi
clem: Cui autem aliquid donastis, et ego: nam et ego quod donavi, si quid donavi, propter vos in persona Christi,
tr: ω δε τι χαριζεσθε και εγω και γαρ εγω ει τι κεχαρισμαι ω κεχαρισμαι δι υμας εν προσωπω χριστου
kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

vulg: ut non circumveniamur a Satana non enim ignoramus cogitationes eius
clem: ut non circumveniamur a Satana: non enim ignoramus cogitationes ejus.
tr: ινα μη πλεονεκτηθωμεν υπο του σατανα ου γαρ αυτου τα νοηματα αγνοουμεν
kjv: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

vulg: cum venissem autem Troadem propter evangelium Christi et ostium mihi apertum esset in Domino
clem: Cum venissem autem Troadem propter Evangelium Christi, et ostium mihi apertum esset in Domino,
tr: ελθων δε εις την τρωαδα εις το ευαγγελιον του χριστου και θυρας μοι ανεωγμενης εν κυριω
kjv: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

vulg: non habui requiem spiritui meo eo quod non invenerim Titum fratrem meum sed valefaciens eis profectus sum in Macedoniam
clem: non habui requiem spiritui meo, eo quod non invenerim Titum fratrem meum, sed valefaciens eis, profectus sum in Macedoniam.
tr: ουκ εσχηκα ανεσιν τω πνευματι μου τω μη ευρειν με τιτον τον αδελφον μου αλλα αποταξαμενος αυτοις εξηλθον εις μακεδονιαν
kjv: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

vulg: Deo autem gratias qui semper triumphat nos in Christo Iesu et odorem notitiae suae manifestat per nos in omni loco
clem: Deo autem gratias, qui semper triumphat nos in Christo Jesu, et odorem notiti su manifestat per nos in omni loco:
tr: τω δε θεω χαρις τω παντοτε θριαμβευοντι ημας εν τω χριστω και την οσμην της γνωσεως αυτου φανερουντι δι ημων εν παντι τοπω
kjv: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

vulg: quia Christi bonus odor sumus Deo in his qui salvi fiunt et in his qui pereunt
clem: quia Christi bonus odor sumus Deo in iis qui salvi fiunt, et in his qui pereunt:
tr: οτι χριστου ευωδια εσμεν τω θεω εν τοις σωζομενοις και εν τοις απολλυμενοις
kjv: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

vulg: aliis quidem odor mortis in mortem aliis autem odor vitae in vitam et ad haec quis tam idoneus
clem: aliis quidem odor mortis in mortem: aliis autem odor vit in vitam. Et ad hc quis tam idoneus?
tr: οις μεν οσμη θανατου εις θανατον οις δε οσμη ζωης εις ζωην και προς ταυτα τις ικανος
kjv: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

vulg: non enim sumus sicut plurimi adulterantes verbum Dei sed ex sinceritate sed sicut ex Deo coram Deo in Christo loquimur
clem: non enim sumus sicut plurimi, adulterantes verbum Dei, sed ex sinceritate, sed sicut ex Deo, coram Deo, in Christo loquimur.
tr: ου γαρ εσμεν ως οι πολλοι καπηλευοντες τον λογον του θεου αλλ ως εξ ειλικρινειας αλλ ως εκ θεου κατενωπιον του θεου εν χριστω λαλουμεν
kjv: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

vulg: incipimus iterum nosmet ipsos commendare aut numquid egemus sicut quidam commendaticiis epistulis ad vos aut ex vobis
clem: Incipimus iterum nosmetipsos commendare? aut numquid egemus (sicut quidam) commendatiis epistolis ad vos, aut ex vobis?
tr: αρχομεθα παλιν εαυτους συνιστανειν ει  η  μη χρηζομεν ως τινες συστατικων επιστολων προς υμας η εξ υμων συστατικων
kjv: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

vulg: epistula nostra vos estis scripta in cordibus nostris quae scitur et legitur ab omnibus hominibus
clem: Epistola nostra vos estis, scripta in cordibus nostris, qu scitur, et legitur ab omnibus hominibus:
tr: η επιστολη ημων υμεις εστε εγγεγραμμενη εν ταις καρδιαις ημων γινωσκομενη και αναγινωσκομενη υπο παντων ανθρωπων
kjv: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

vulg: manifestati quoniam epistula estis Christi ministrata a nobis et scripta non atramento sed Spiritu Dei vivi non in tabulis lapideis sed in tabulis cordis carnalibus
clem: manifestati quod epistola estis Christi, ministrata a nobis, et scripta non atramento, sed Spiritu Dei vivi: non in tabulis lapideis, sed in tabulis cordis carnalibus.
tr: φανερουμενοι οτι εστε επιστολη χριστου διακονηθεισα υφ ημων εγγεγραμμενη ου μελανι αλλα πνευματι θεου ζωντος ουκ εν πλαξιν λιθιναις αλλ εν πλαξιν καρδιας σαρκιναις
kjv: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

vulg: fiduciam autem talem habemus per Christum ad Deum
clem: Fiduciam autem talem habemus per Christum ad Deum:
tr: πεποιθησιν δε τοιαυτην εχομεν δια του χριστου προς τον θεον
kjv: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

vulg: non quod sufficientes simus cogitare aliquid a nobis quasi ex nobis sed sufficientia nostra ex Deo est
clem: non quod sufficientes simus cogitare aliquid a nobis, quasi ex nobis: sed sufficientia nostra ex Deo est:
tr: ουχ οτι ικανοι εσμεν αφ εαυτων λογισασθαι τι ως εξ εαυτων αλλ η ικανοτης ημων εκ του θεου
kjv: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

vulg: qui et idoneos nos fecit ministros novi testamenti non litterae sed Spiritus littera enim occidit Spiritus autem vivificat
clem: qui et idoneos nos fecit ministros novi testamenti: non littera, sed Spiritu: littera enim occidit, Spiritus autem vivificat.
tr: ος και ικανωσεν ημας διακονους καινης διαθηκης ου γραμματος αλλα πνευματος το γαρ γραμμα αποκτεινει το δε πνευμα ζωοποιει
kjv: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

vulg: quod si ministratio mortis litteris deformata in lapidibus fuit in gloria ita ut non possent intendere filii Israhel in faciem Mosi propter gloriam vultus eius quae evacuatur
clem: Quod si ministratio mortis litteris deformata in lapidibus fuit in gloria, ita ut non possent intendere filii Isral in faciem Moysi propter gloriam vultus ejus, qu evacuatur:
tr: ει δε η διακονια του θανατου εν γραμμασιν εντετυπωμενη εν λιθοις εγενηθη εν δοξη ωστε μη δυνασθαι ατενισαι τους υιους ισραηλ εις το προσωπον μωσεως δια την δοξαν του προσωπου αυτου την καταργουμενην
kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

vulg: quomodo non magis ministratio Spiritus erit in gloria
clem: quomodo non magis ministratio Spiritus erit in gloria?
tr: πως ουχι μαλλον η διακονια του πνευματος εσται εν δοξη
kjv: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

vulg: nam si ministratio damnationis gloria est multo magis abundat ministerium iustitiae in gloria
clem: Nam si ministratio damnationis gloria est: multo magis abundat ministerium justiti in gloria.
tr: ει γαρ η διακονια της κατακρισεως δοξα πολλω μαλλον περισσευει η διακονια της δικαιοσυνης εν δοξη
kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

vulg: nam nec glorificatum est quod claruit in hac parte propter excellentem gloriam
clem: Nam nec glorificatum est, quod claruit in hac parte, propter excellentem gloriam.
tr: και γαρ ουδε δεδοξασται το δεδοξασμενον εν τουτω τω μερει ενεκεν της υπερβαλλουσης δοξης
kjv: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

vulg: si enim quod evacuatur per gloriam est multo magis quod manet in gloria est
clem: Si enim quod evacuatur, per gloriam est: multo magis quod manet, in gloria est.
tr: ει γαρ το καταργουμενον δια δοξης πολλω μαλλον το μενον εν δοξη
kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

vulg: habentes igitur talem spem multa fiducia utimur
clem: Habentes igitur talem spem, multa fiducia utimur:
tr: εχοντες ουν τοιαυτην ελπιδα πολλη παρρησια χρωμεθα
kjv: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

vulg: et non sicut Moses ponebat velamen super faciem suam ut non intenderent filii Israhel in faciem eius quod evacuatur
clem: et non sicut Moyses ponebat velamen super faciem suam, ut non intenderent filii Isral in faciem ejus, quod evacuatur,
tr: και ου καθαπερ μωσης ετιθει καλυμμα επι το προσωπον εαυτου προς το μη ατενισαι τους υιους ισραηλ εις το τελος του καταργουμενου
kjv: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

vulg: sed obtusi sunt sensus eorum usque in hodiernum enim diem id ipsum velamen in lectione veteris testamenti manet non revelatum quoniam in Christo evacuatur
clem: sed obtusi sunt sensus eorum. Usque in hodiernum enim diem, idipsum velamen in lectione veteris testamenti manet non revelatum (quoniam in Christo evacuatur),
tr: αλλ επωρωθη τα νοηματα αυτων αχρι γαρ της σημερον το αυτο καλυμμα επι τη αναγνωσει της παλαιας διαθηκης μενει μη ανακαλυπτομενον ο τι εν χριστω καταργειται
kjv: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

vulg: sed usque in hodiernum diem cum legitur Moses velamen est positum super cor eorum
clem: sed usque in hodiernum diem, cum legitur Moyses, velamen positum est super cor eorum.
tr: αλλ εως σημερον ηνικα αναγινωσκεται μωσης καλυμμα επι την καρδιαν αυτων κειται
kjv: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

vulg: cum autem conversus fuerit ad Deum aufertur velamen
clem: Cum autem conversus fuerit ad Dominum, auferetur velamen.
tr: ηνικα δ αν επιστρεψη προς κυριον περιαιρειται το καλυμμα
kjv: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

vulg: Dominus autem Spiritus est ubi autem Spiritus Domini ibi libertas
clem: Dominus autem Spiritus est: ubi autem Spiritus Domini, ibi libertas.
tr: ο δε κυριος το πνευμα εστιν ου δε το πνευμα κυριου εκει ελευθερια
kjv: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

vulg: nos vero omnes revelata facie gloriam Domini speculantes in eandem imaginem transformamur a claritate in claritatem tamquam a Domini Spiritu
clem: Nos vero omnes, revelata facie gloriam Domini speculantes, in eamdem imaginem transformamur a claritate in claritatem, tamquam a Domini Spiritu.
tr: ημεις δε παντες ανακεκαλυμμενω προσωπω την δοξαν κυριου κατοπτριζομενοι την αυτην εικονα μεταμορφουμεθα απο δοξης εις δοξαν καθαπερ απο κυριου πνευματος
kjv: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

vulg: ideo habentes hanc ministrationem iuxta quod misericordiam consecuti sumus non deficimus
clem: Ideo habentes administrationem, juxta quod misericordiam consecuti sumus, non deficimus,
tr: δια τουτο εχοντες την διακονιαν ταυτην καθως ηλεηθημεν ουκ εκκακουμεν
kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

vulg: sed abdicamus occulta dedecoris non ambulantes in astutia neque adulterantes verbum Dei sed in manifestatione veritatis commendantes nosmet ipsos ad omnem conscientiam hominum coram Deo
clem: sed abdicamus occulta dedecoris, non ambulantes in astutia, neque adulterantes verbum Dei, sed in manifestatione veritatis commendantes nosmetipsos ad omnem conscientiam hominum coram Deo.
tr: αλλ απειπαμεθα τα κρυπτα της αισχυνης μη περιπατουντες εν πανουργια μηδε δολουντες τον λογον του θεου αλλα τη φανερωσει της αληθειας συνιστωντες εαυτους προς πασαν συνειδησιν ανθρωπων ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

vulg: quod si etiam opertum est evangelium nostrum in his qui pereunt est opertum
clem: Quod si etiam opertum est Evangelium nostrum, in iis, qui pereunt, est opertum:
tr: ει δε και εστιν κεκαλυμμενον το ευαγγελιον ημων εν τοις απολλυμενοις εστιν κεκαλυμμενον
kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

vulg: in quibus deus huius saeculi excaecavit mentes infidelium ut non fulgeat inluminatio evangelii gloriae Christi qui est imago Dei
clem: in quibus Deus hujus sculi exccavit mentes infidelium, ut non fulgeat illis illuminatio Evangelii glori Christi, qui est imago Dei.
tr: εν οις ο θεος του αιωνος τουτου ετυφλωσεν τα νοηματα των απιστων εις το μη αυγασαι αυτοις τον φωτισμον του ευαγγελιου της δοξης του χριστου ος εστιν εικων του θεου
kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

vulg: non enim nosmet ipsos praedicamus sed Iesum Christum Dominum nos autem servos vestros per Iesum
clem: Non enim nosmetipsos prdicamus, sed Jesum Christum Dominum nostrum: nos autem servos vestros per Jesum:
tr: ου γαρ εαυτους κηρυσσομεν αλλα χριστον ιησουν κυριον εαυτους δε δουλους υμων δια ιησουν
kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

vulg: quoniam Deus qui dixit de tenebris lucem splendescere qui inluxit in cordibus nostris ad inluminationem scientiae claritatis Dei in facie Christi Iesu
clem: quoniam Deus, qui dixit de tenebris lucem splendescere, ipse illuxit in cordibus nostris ad illuminationem scienti claritatis Dei, in facie Christi Jesu.
tr: οτι ο θεος ο ειπων εκ σκοτους φως λαμψαι ος ελαμψεν εν ταις καρδιαις ημων προς φωτισμον της γνωσεως της δοξης του θεου εν προσωπω ιησου χριστου
kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

vulg: habemus autem thesaurum istum in vasis fictilibus ut sublimitas sit virtutis Dei et non ex nobis
clem: Habemus autem thesaurum istum in vasis fictilibus: ut sublimitas sit virtutis Dei, et non ex nobis.
tr: εχομεν δε τον θησαυρον τουτον εν οστρακινοις σκευεσιν ινα η υπερβολη της δυναμεως η του θεου και μη εξ ημων
kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

vulg: in omnibus tribulationem patimur sed non angustiamur aporiamur sed non destituimur
clem: In omnibus tribulationem patimur, sed non angustiamur: aporiamur, sed non destituimur:
tr: εν παντι θλιβομενοι αλλ ου στενοχωρουμενοι απορουμενοι αλλ ουκ εξαπορουμενοι
kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

vulg: persecutionem patimur sed non derelinquimur deicimur sed non perimus
clem: persecutionem patimur, sed non derelinquimur: dejicimur, sed non perimus:
tr: διωκομενοι αλλ ουκ εγκαταλειπομενοι καταβαλλομενοι αλλ ουκ απολλυμενοι
kjv: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

vulg: semper mortificationem Iesu in corpore nostro circumferentes ut et vita Iesu in corporibus nostris manifestetur
clem: semper mortificationem Jesu in corpore nostro circumferentes, ut et vita Jesu manifestetur in corporibus nostris.
tr: παντοτε την νεκρωσιν του κυριου ιησου εν τω σωματι περιφεροντες ινα και η ζωη του ιησου εν τω σωματι ημων φανερωθη
kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

vulg: semper enim nos qui vivimus in mortem tradimur propter Iesum ut et vita Iesu manifestetur in carne nostra mortali
clem: Semper enim nos, qui vivimus, in mortem tradimur propter Jesum: ut et vita Jesu manifestetur in carne nostra mortali.
tr: αει γαρ ημεις οι ζωντες εις θανατον παραδιδομεθα δια ιησουν ινα και η ζωη του ιησου φανερωθη εν τη θνητη σαρκι ημων
kjv: For we which live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

vulg: ergo mors in nobis operatur vita autem in vobis
clem: Ergo mors in nobis operatur, vita autem in vobis.
tr: ωστε ο μεν θανατος εν ημιν ενεργειται η δε ζωη εν υμιν
kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

vulg: habentes autem eundem spiritum fidei sicut scriptum est credidi propter quod locutus sum et nos credimus propter quod et loquimur
clem: Habentes autem eumdem spiritum fidei, sicut scriptum est: Credidi, propter quod locutus sum: et nos credimus, propter quod et loquimur:
tr: εχοντες δε το αυτο πνευμα της πιστεως κατα το γεγραμμενον επιστευσα διο ελαλησα και ημεις πιστευομεν διο και λαλουμεν
kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

vulg: scientes quoniam qui suscitavit Iesum et nos cum Iesu suscitabit et constituet vobiscum
clem: scientes quoniam qui suscitavit Jesum, et nos cum Jesu suscitabit, et constituet vobiscum.
tr: ειδοτες οτι ο εγειρας τον κυριον ιησουν και ημας δια ιησου εγερει και παραστησει συν υμιν
kjv: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

vulg: omnia enim propter vos ut gratia abundans per multos gratiarum actione abundet in gloriam Dei
clem: Omnia enim propter vos: ut gratia abundans, per multos in gratiarum actione, abundet in gloriam Dei.
tr: τα γαρ παντα δι υμας ινα η χαρις πλεονασασα δια των πλειονων την ευχαριστιαν περισσευση εις την δοξαν του θεου
kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

vulg: propter quod non deficimus sed licet is qui foris est noster homo corrumpitur tamen is qui intus est renovatur de die in diem
clem: Propter quod non deficimus: sed licet is, qui foris est, noster homo corrumpatur, tamen is, qui intus est, renovatur de die in diem.
tr: διο ουκ εκκακουμεν αλλ ει και ο εξω ημων ανθρωπος διαφθειρεται αλλ ο εσωθεν ανακαινουται ημερα και ημερα
kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

vulg: id enim quod in praesenti est momentaneum et leve tribulationis nostrae supra modum in sublimitatem aeternum gloriae pondus operatur nobis
clem: Id enim, quod in prsenti est momentaneum et leve tribulationis nostr, supra modum in sublimitate ternum glori pondus operatur in nobis,
tr: το γαρ παραυτικα ελαφρον της θλιψεως ημων καθ υπερβολην εις υπερβολην αιωνιον βαρος δοξης κατεργαζεται ημιν
kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

vulg: non contemplantibus nobis quae videntur sed quae non videntur quae enim videntur temporalia sunt quae autem non videntur aeterna sunt
clem: non contemplantibus nobis qu videntur, sed qu non videntur. Qu enim videntur, temporalia sunt: qu autem non videntur, terna sunt.
tr: μη σκοπουντων ημων τα βλεπομενα αλλα τα μη βλεπομενα τα γαρ βλεπομενα προσκαιρα τα δε μη βλεπομενα αιωνια
kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

vulg: scimus enim quoniam si terrestris domus nostra huius habitationis dissolvatur quod aedificationem ex Deo habeamus domum non manufactam aeternam in caelis
clem: Scimus enim quoniam si terrestris domus nostra hujus habitationis dissolvatur, quod dificationem ex Deo habemus, domum non manufactam, ternam in clis.
tr: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι εαν η επιγειος ημων οικια του σκηνους καταλυθη οικοδομην εκ θεου εχομεν οικιαν αχειροποιητον αιωνιον εν τοις ουρανοις
kjv: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

vulg: nam et in hoc ingemescimus habitationem nostram quae de caelo est superindui cupientes
clem: Nam et in hoc ingemiscimus, habitationem nostram, qu de clo est, superindui cupientes:
tr: και γαρ εν τουτω στεναζομεν το οικητηριον ημων το εξ ουρανου επενδυσασθαι επιποθουντες
kjv: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

vulg: si tamen vestiti non nudi inveniamur
clem: si tamen vestiti, non nudi inveniamur.
tr: ειγε και ενδυσαμενοι ου γυμνοι ευρεθησομεθα
kjv: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

vulg: nam et qui sumus in tabernaculo ingemescimus gravati eo quod nolumus expoliari sed supervestiri ut absorbeatur quod mortale est a vita
clem: Nam et qui sumus in hoc tabernaculo, ingemiscimus gravati: eo quod nolumus expoliari, sed supervestiri, ut absorbeatur quod mortale est, a vita.
tr: και γαρ οι οντες εν τω σκηνει στεναζομεν βαρουμενοι επειδη  εφ ω  ου θελομεν εκδυσασθαι αλλ επενδυσασθαι ινα καταποθη το θνητον υπο της ζωης
kjv: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

vulg: qui autem efficit nos in hoc ipsum Deus qui dedit nobis pignus Spiritus
clem: Qui autem efficit nos in hoc ipsum, Deus, qui dedit nobis pignus Spiritus.
tr: ο δε κατεργασαμενος ημας εις αυτο τουτο θεος ο και δους ημιν τον αρραβωνα του πνευματος
kjv: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

vulg: audentes igitur semper et scientes quoniam dum sumus in corpore peregrinamur a Domino
clem: Audentes igitur semper, scientes quoniam dum sumus in corpore, peregrinamur a Domino
tr: θαρρουντες ουν παντοτε και ειδοτες οτι ενδημουντες εν τω σωματι εκδημουμεν απο του κυριου
kjv: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

vulg: per fidem enim ambulamus et non per speciem
clem: (per fidem enim ambulamus, et non per speciem):
tr: δια πιστεως γαρ περιπατουμεν ου δια ειδους
kjv: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

vulg: audemus autem et bonam voluntatem habemus magis peregrinari a corpore et praesentes esse ad Deum
clem: audemus autem, et bonam voluntatem habemus magis peregrinari a corpore, et prsentes esse ad Dominum.
tr: θαρρουμεν δε και ευδοκουμεν μαλλον εκδημησαι εκ του σωματος και ενδημησαι προς τον κυριον
kjv: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

vulg: et ideo contendimus sive absentes sive praesentes placere illi
clem: Et ideo contendimus, sive absentes, sive prsentes, placere illi.
tr: διο και φιλοτιμουμεθα ειτε ενδημουντες ειτε εκδημουντες ευαρεστοι αυτω ειναι
kjv: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

vulg: omnes enim nos manifestari oportet ante tribunal Christi ut referat unusquisque propria corporis prout gessit sive bonum sive malum
clem: Omnes enim non manifestari oportet ante tribunal Christi, ut referat unusquisque propria corporis, prout gessit, sive bonum, sive malum.
tr: τους γαρ παντας ημας φανερωθηναι δει εμπροσθεν του βηματος του χριστου ινα κομισηται εκαστος τα δια του σωματος προς α επραξεν ειτε αγαθον ειτε κακον
kjv: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

vulg: scientes ergo timorem Domini hominibus suademus Deo autem manifesti sumus spero autem et in conscientiis vestris manifestos nos esse
clem: Scientes ergo timorem Domini, hominibus suademus, Deo autem manifesti sumus. Spero autem et in conscientiis vestris manifestos nos esse.
tr: ειδοτες ουν τον φοβον του κυριου ανθρωπους πειθομεν θεω δε πεφανερωμεθα ελπιζω δε και εν ταις συνειδησεσιν υμων πεφανερωσθαι
kjv: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

vulg: non iterum nos commendamus vobis sed occasionem damus vobis gloriandi pro nobis ut habeatis ad eos qui in facie gloriantur et non in corde
clem: Non iterum commendamus nos vobis, sed occasionem damus vobis gloriandi pro nobis: ut habeatis ad eos qui in facie gloriantur, et non in corde.
tr: ου γαρ παλιν εαυτους συνιστανομεν υμιν αλλα αφορμην διδοντες υμιν καυχηματος υπερ ημων ινα εχητε προς τους εν προσωπω καυχωμενους και ου καρδια
kjv: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

vulg: sive enim mente excedimus Deo sive sobrii sumus vobis
clem: Sive enim mente excedimus Deo: sive sobrii sumus, vobis.
tr: ειτε γαρ εξεστημεν θεω ειτε σωφρονουμεν υμιν
kjv: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

vulg: caritas enim Christi urget nos aestimantes hoc quoniam si unus pro omnibus mortuus est ergo omnes mortui sunt
clem: Caritas enim Christi urget nos: stimantes hoc, quoniam si unus pro omnibus mortuus est, ergo omnes mortui sunt:
tr: η γαρ αγαπη του χριστου συνεχει ημας κριναντας τουτο οτι ει εις υπερ παντων απεθανεν αρα οι παντες απεθανον
kjv: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

vulg: et pro omnibus mortuus est ut et qui vivunt iam non sibi vivant sed ei qui pro ipsis mortuus est et resurrexit
clem: et pro omnibus mortuus est Christus: ut, et qui vivunt, jam non sibi vivant, sed ei qui pro ipsis mortuus est et resurrexit.
tr: και υπερ παντων απεθανεν ινα οι ζωντες μηκετι εαυτοις ζωσιν αλλα τω υπερ αυτων αποθανοντι και εγερθεντι
kjv: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

vulg: itaque nos ex hoc neminem novimus secundum carnem et si cognovimus secundum carnem Christum sed nunc iam non novimus
clem: Itaque nos ex hoc neminem novimus secundum carnem. Et si cognovimus secundum carnem Christum, sed nunc jam non novimus.
tr: ωστε ημεις απο του νυν ουδενα οιδαμεν κατα σαρκα ει δε και εγνωκαμεν κατα σαρκα χριστον αλλα νυν ουκετι γινωσκομεν
kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

vulg: si qua ergo in Christo nova creatura vetera transierunt ecce facta sunt nova
clem: Si qua ergo in Christo nova creatura, vetera transierunt: ecce facta sunt omnia nova.
tr: ωστε ει τις εν χριστω καινη κτισις τα αρχαια παρηλθεν ιδου γεγονεν καινα τα παντα
kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

vulg: omnia autem ex Deo qui reconciliavit nos sibi per Christum et dedit nobis ministerium reconciliationis
clem: Omnia autem ex Deo, qui nos reconciliavit sibi per Christum: et dedit nobis ministerium reconciliationis,
tr: τα δε παντα εκ του θεου του καταλλαξαντος ημας εαυτω δια ιησου χριστου και δοντος ημιν την διακονιαν της καταλλαγης
kjv: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

vulg: quoniam quidem Deus erat in Christo mundum reconcilians sibi non reputans illis delicta ipsorum et posuit in nobis verbum reconciliationis
clem: quoniam quidem Deus erat in Christo mundum reconcilians sibi, non reputans illis delicta ipsorum, et posuit in nobis verbum reconciliationis.
tr: ως οτι θεος ην εν χριστω κοσμον καταλλασσων εαυτω μη λογιζομενος αυτοις τα παραπτωματα αυτων και θεμενος εν ημιν τον λογον της καταλλαγης
kjv: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

vulg: pro Christo ergo legationem fungimur tamquam Deo exhortante per nos obsecramus pro Christo reconciliamini Deo
clem: Pro Christo ergo legatione fungimur, tamquam Deo exhortante per nos. Obsecramus pro Christo, reconciliamini Deo.
tr: υπερ χριστου ουν πρεσβευομεν ως του θεου παρακαλουντος δι ημων δεομεθα υπερ χριστου καταλλαγητε τω θεω
kjv: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

vulg: eum qui non noverat peccatum pro nobis peccatum fecit ut nos efficeremur iustitia Dei in ipso
clem: Eum, qui non noverat peccatum, pro nobis peccatum fecit, ut nos efficeremur justitia Dei in ipso.
tr: τον γαρ μη γνοντα αμαρτιαν υπερ ημων αμαρτιαν εποιησεν ινα ημεις γινωμεθα δικαιοσυνη θεου εν αυτω
kjv: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

vulg: adiuvantes autem et exhortamur ne in vacuum gratiam Dei recipiatis
clem: Adjuvantes autem exhortamur ne in vacuum gratiam Dei recipiatis.
tr: συνεργουντες δε και παρακαλουμεν μη εις κενον την χαριν του θεου δεξασθαι υμας
kjv: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

vulg: ait enim tempore accepto exaudivi te et in die salutis adiuvavi te ecce nunc tempus acceptabile ecce nunc dies salutis
clem: Ait enim: Tempore accepto exaudivi te, et in die salutis adjuvi te. Ecce nunc tempus acceptabile, ecce nunc dies salutis.
tr: λεγει γαρ καιρω δεκτω επηκουσα σου και εν ημερα σωτηριας εβοηθησα σοι ιδου νυν καιρος ευπροσδεκτος ιδου νυν ημερα σωτηριας
kjv: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

vulg: nemini dantes ullam offensionem ut non vituperetur ministerium
clem: Nemini dantes ullam offensionem, ut non vituperetur ministerium nostrum:
tr: μηδεμιαν εν μηδενι διδοντες προσκοπην ινα μη μωμηθη η διακονια
kjv: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

vulg: sed in omnibus exhibeamus nosmet ipsos sicut Dei ministros in multa patientia in tribulationibus in necessitatibus in angustiis
clem: sed in omnibus exhibeamus nosmetipsos sicut Dei ministros in multa patientia, in tribulationibus, in necessitatibus, in angustiis,
tr: αλλ εν παντι συνιστωντες εαυτους ως θεου διακονοι εν υπομονη πολλη εν θλιψεσιν εν αναγκαις εν στενοχωριαις
kjv: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

vulg: in plagis in carceribus in seditionibus in laboribus in vigiliis in ieiuniis
clem: in plagis, in carceribus, in seditionibus, in laboribus, in vigiliis, in jejuniis,
tr: εν πληγαις εν φυλακαις εν ακαταστασιαις εν κοποις εν αγρυπνιαις εν νηστειαις
kjv: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

vulg: in castitate in scientia in longanimitate in suavitate in Spiritu Sancto in caritate non ficta
clem: in castitate, in scientia, in longanimitate, in suavitate, in Spiritu Sancto, in caritate non ficta,
tr: εν αγνοτητι εν γνωσει εν μακροθυμια εν χρηστοτητι εν πνευματι αγιω εν αγαπη ανυποκριτω
kjv: By pureness, by knowledge, by long suffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

vulg: in verbo veritatis in virtute Dei per arma iustitiae a dextris et sinistris
clem: in verbo veritatis, in virtute Dei, per arma justiti a dextris et a sinistris,
tr: εν λογω αληθειας εν δυναμει θεου δια των οπλων της δικαιοσυνης των δεξιων και αριστερων
kjv: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

vulg: per gloriam et ignobilitatem per infamiam et bonam famam ut seductores et veraces sicut qui ignoti et cogniti
clem: per gloriam, et ignobilitatem, per infamiam, et bonam famam: ut seductores, et veraces, sicut qui ignoti, et cogniti:
tr: δια δοξης και ατιμιας δια δυσφημιας και ευφημιας ως πλανοι και αληθεις
kjv: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

vulg: quasi morientes et ecce vivimus ut castigati et non mortificati
clem: quasi morientes, et ecce vivimus: ut castigati, et non mortificati:
tr: ως αγνοουμενοι και επιγινωσκομενοι ως αποθνησκοντες και ιδου ζωμεν ως παιδευομενοι και μη θανατουμενοι
kjv: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

vulg: quasi tristes semper autem gaudentes sicut egentes multos autem locupletantes tamquam nihil habentes et omnia possidentes
clem: quasi tristes, semper autem gaudentes: sicut egentes, multos autem locupletantes: tamquam nihil habentes, et omnia possidentes.
tr: ως λυπουμενοι αει δε χαιροντες ως πτωχοι πολλους δε πλουτιζοντες ως μηδεν εχοντες και παντα κατεχοντες
kjv: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

vulg: os nostrum patet ad vos o Corinthii cor nostrum dilatatum est
clem: Os nostrum patet ad vos, o Corinthii; cor nostrum dilatatum est.
tr: το στομα ημων ανεωγεν προς υμας κορινθιοι η καρδια ημων πεπλατυνται
kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

vulg: non angustiamini in nobis angustiamini autem in visceribus vestris
clem: Non angustiamini in nobis: angustiamini autem in visceribus vestris:
tr: ου στενοχωρεισθε εν ημιν στενοχωρεισθε δε εν τοις σπλαγχνοις υμων
kjv: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

vulg: eandem autem habentes remunerationem tamquam filiis dico dilatamini et vos
clem: eamdem autem habentes renumerationem, tamquam filiis dico, dilatamini et vos.
tr: την δε αυτην αντιμισθιαν ως τεκνοις λεγω πλατυνθητε και υμεις
kjv: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

vulg: nolite iugum ducere cum infidelibus quae enim participatio iustitiae cum iniquitate aut quae societas luci ad tenebras
clem: Nolite jugum ducere cum infidelibus. Qu enim participatio justiti cum iniquitate? aut qu societas luci ad tenebras?
tr: μη γινεσθε ετεροζυγουντες απιστοις τις γαρ μετοχη δικαιοσυνη και ανομια τις δε κοινωνια φωτι προς σκοτος
kjv: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

vulg: quae autem conventio Christi ad Belial aut quae pars fideli cum infidele
clem: qu autem conventio Christi ad Belial? aut qu pars fideli cum infideli?
tr: τις δε συμφωνησις χριστω προς βελιαρ  βελιαλ  η τις μερις πιστω μετα απιστου
kjv: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

vulg: qui autem consensus templo Dei cum idolis vos enim estis templum Dei vivi sicut dicit Deus quoniam inhabitabo in illis et inambulabo et ero illorum Deus et ipsi erunt mihi populus
clem: qui autem consensus templo Dei cum idolis? vos enim estis templum Dei vivi, sicut dicit Deus: [Quoniam inhabitabo in illis, et inambulabo inter eos, et ero illorum Deus, et ipsi erunt mihi populus.
tr: τις δε συγκαταθεσις ναω θεου μετα ειδωλων υμεις γαρ ναος θεου εστε ζωντος καθως ειπεν ο θεος οτι ενοικησω εν αυτοις και εμπεριπατησω και εσομαι αυτων θεος και αυτοι εσονται μοι λαος
kjv: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

vulg: propter quod exite de medio eorum et separamini dicit Dominus et inmundum ne tetigeritis
clem: Propter quod exite de medio eorum, et separamini, dicit Dominus, et immundum ne tetigeritis:
tr: διο εξελθετε εκ μεσου αυτων και αφορισθητε λεγει κυριος και ακαθαρτου μη απτεσθε καγω εισδεξομαι υμας
kjv: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.

vulg: et ego recipiam vos et ero vobis in patrem et vos eritis mihi in filios et filias dicit Dominus omnipotens
clem: et ego recipiam vos: et ero vobis in patrem, et vos eritis mihi in filios et filias, dicit Dominus omnipotens.]
tr: και εσομαι υμιν εις πατερα και υμεις εσεσθε μοι εις υιους και θυγατερας λεγει κυριος παντοκρατωρ
kjv: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

vulg: has igitur habentes promissiones carissimi mundemus nos ab omni inquinamento carnis et spiritus perficientes sanctificationem in timore Dei
clem: Has ergo habentes promissiones, carissimi, mundemus nos ab omni inquinamento carnis et spiritus, perficientes sanctificationem in timore Dei.
tr: ταυτας ουν εχοντες τας επαγγελιας αγαπητοι καθαρισωμεν εαυτους απο παντος μολυσμου σαρκος και πνευματος επιτελουντες αγιωσυνην εν φοβω θεου
kjv: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

vulg: capite nos neminem laesimus neminem corrupimus neminem circumvenimus
clem: Capite nos. Neminem lsimus, neminem corrupimus, neminem circumvenimus.
tr: χωρησατε ημας ουδενα ηδικησαμεν ουδενα εφθειραμεν ουδενα επλεονεκτησαμεν
kjv: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

vulg: non ad condemnationem dico praedixi enim quod in cordibus nostris estis ad conmoriendum et ad convivendum
clem: Non ad condemnationem vestram dico: prdiximus enim quod in cordibus nostris estis ad commoriendum et ad convivendum.
tr: ου προς κατακρισιν λεγω προειρηκα γαρ οτι εν ταις καρδιαις ημων εστε εις το συναποθανειν και συζην
kjv: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

vulg: multa mihi fiducia est apud vos multa mihi gloriatio pro vobis repletus sum consolatione superabundo gaudio in omni tribulatione nostra
clem: Multa mihi fiducia est apud vos, multa mihi gloriatio pro vobis: repletus sum consolatione; superabundo gaudio in omni tribulatione nostra.
tr: πολλη μοι παρρησια προς υμας πολλη μοι καυχησις υπερ υμων πεπληρωμαι τη παρακλησει υπερπερισσευομαι τη χαρα επι παση τη θλιψει ημων
kjv: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

vulg: nam et cum venissemus Macedoniam nullam requiem habuit caro nostra sed omnem tribulationem passi foris pugnae intus timores
clem: Nam et cum venissemus in Macedoniam, nullam requiem habuit caro nostra, sed omnem tribulationem passi sumus: foris pugn, intus timores.
tr: και γαρ ελθοντων ημων εις μακεδονιαν ουδεμιαν εσχηκεν ανεσιν η σαρξ ημων αλλ εν παντι θλιβομενοι εξωθεν μαχαι εσωθεν φοβοι
kjv: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

vulg: sed qui consolatur humiles consolatus est nos Deus in adventu Titi
clem: Sed qui consolatur humiles, consolatus est nos Deus in adventu Titi.
tr: αλλ ο παρακαλων τους ταπεινους παρεκαλεσεν ημας ο θεος εν τη παρουσια τιτου
kjv: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

vulg: non solum autem in adventu eius sed etiam in solacio quo consolatus est in vobis referens nobis vestrum desiderium vestrum fletum vestram aemulationem pro me ita ut magis gauderem
clem: Non solum autem in adventu ejus, sed etiam in consolatione, qua consolatus est in vobis, referens nobis vestrum desiderium, vestrum fletum, vestram mulationem pro me, ita ut magis gauderem.
tr: ου μονον δε εν τη παρουσια αυτου αλλα και εν τη παρακλησει η παρεκληθη εφ υμιν αναγγελλων ημιν την υμων επιποθησιν τον υμων οδυρμον τον υμων ζηλον υπερ εμου ωστε με μαλλον χαρηναι
kjv: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

vulg: quoniam et si contristavi vos in epistula non me paenitet et si paeniteret videns quod epistula illa et si ad horam vos contristavit
clem: Quoniam etsi contristavi vos in epistola, non me pnitet: etsi pniteret, videns quod epistola illa (etsi ad horam) vos contristavit,
tr: οτι ει και ελυπησα υμας εν τη επιστολη ου μεταμελομαι ει και μετεμελομην βλεπω γαρ οτι η επιστολη εκεινη ει και προς ωραν ελυπησεν υμας
kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

vulg: nunc gaudeo non quia contristati estis sed quia contristati estis ad paenitentiam contristati enim estis secundum Deum ut in nullo detrimentum patiamini ex nobis
clem: nunc gaudeo: non quia contristati estis, sed quia contristati estis ad pnitentiam. Contristati enim estis ad Deum, ut in nullo detrimentum patiamini ex nobis.
tr: νυν χαιρω ουχ οτι ελυπηθητε αλλ οτι ελυπηθητε εις μετανοιαν ελυπηθητε γαρ κατα θεον ινα εν μηδενι ζημιωθητε εξ ημων
kjv: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

vulg: quae enim secundum Deum tristitia est paenitentiam in salutem stabilem operatur saeculi autem tristitia mortem operatur
clem: Qu enim secundum Deum tristitia est, pnitentiam in salutem stabilem operatur: sculi autem tristitia mortem operatur.
tr: η γαρ κατα θεον λυπη μετανοιαν εις σωτηριαν αμεταμελητον κατεργαζεται η δε του κοσμου λυπη θανατον κατεργαζεται
kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

vulg: ecce enim hoc ipsum secundum Deum contristari vos quantam in vobis operatur sollicitudinem sed defensionem sed indignationem sed timorem sed desiderium sed aemulationem sed vindictam in omnibus exhibuistis vos incontaminatos esse negotio
clem: Ecce enim hoc ipsum, secundum Deum contristari vos, quantam in vobis operatur sollicitudinem: sed defensionem, sed indignationem, sed timorem, sed desiderium, sed mulationem, sed vindictam: in omnibus exhibuistis vos incontaminatos esse negotio.
tr: ιδου γαρ αυτο τουτο το κατα θεον λυπηθηναι υμας ποσην κατειργασατο υμιν σπουδην αλλα απολογιαν αλλα αγανακτησιν αλλα φοβον αλλα επιποθησιν αλλα ζηλον αλλ εκδικησιν εν παντι συνεστησατε εαυτους αγνους ειναι εν τω πραγματι
kjv: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

vulg: igitur et si scripsi vobis non propter eum qui fecit iniuriam nec propter eum qui passus est sed ad manifestandam sollicitudinem nostram quam pro vobis habemus ad vos coram Deo
clem: Igitur, etsi scripsi vobis, non propter eum qui fecit injuriam, nec propter eum qui passus est: sed ad manifestandam sollicitudinem nostram, quam habemus pro vobis
tr: αρα ει και εγραψα υμιν ουχ εινεκεν του αδικησαντος ουδε εινεκεν του αδικηθεντος αλλ εινεκεν του φανερωθηναι την σπουδην υμων  ημων  την υπερ ημων  υμων  προς υμας ενωπιον του θεου
kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

vulg: ideo consolati sumus in consolatione autem nostra abundantius magis gavisi sumus super gaudium Titi quia refectus est spiritus eius ab omnibus vobis
clem: coram Deo: ideo consolati sumus. In consolatione autem nostra, abundantius magis gavisi sumus super gaudio Titi, quia refectus est spiritus ejus ab omnibus vobis:
tr: δια τουτο παρακεκλημεθα επι τη παρακλησει υμων περισσοτερως δε μαλλον εχαρημεν επι τη χαρα τιτου οτι αναπεπαυται το πνευμα αυτου απο παντων υμων
kjv: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

vulg: et si quid apud illum de vobis gloriatus sum non sum confusus sed sicut omnia vobis in veritate locuti sumus ita et gloriatio nostra quae fuit ad Titum veritas facta est
clem: et si quid apud illum de vobis gloriatus sum, non sum confusus: sed sicut omnia vobis in veritate locuti sumus, ita et gloriatio nostra, qu fuit ad Titum, veritas facta est,
tr: οτι ει τι αυτω υπερ υμων κεκαυχημαι ου κατησχυνθην αλλ ως παντα εν αληθεια ελαλησαμεν υμιν ουτως και η καυχησις ημων η επι τιτου αληθεια εγενηθη
kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

vulg: et viscera eius abundantius in vos sunt reminiscentis omnium vestrum oboedientiam quomodo cum timore et tremore excepistis eum
clem: et viscera ejus abundantius in vobis sunt, reminiscentis omnium vestrum obedientiam: quomodo cum timore et tremore excepistis illum.
tr: και τα σπλαγχνα αυτου περισσοτερως εις υμας εστιν αναμιμνησκομενου την παντων υμων υπακοην ως μετα φοβου και τρομου εδεξασθε αυτον
kjv: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

vulg: gaudeo quod in omnibus confido in vobis
clem: Gaudeo quod in omnibus confido in vobis.
tr: χαιρω  ουν  οτι εν παντι θαρρω εν υμιν
kjv: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

vulg: notam autem facimus vobis fratres gratiam Dei quae data est in ecclesiis Macedoniae
clem: Notam autem facimus vobis, fratres, gratiam Dei, qu data est in ecclesiis Macedoni:
tr: γνωριζομεν δε υμιν αδελφοι την χαριν του θεου την δεδομενην εν ταις εκκλησιαις της μακεδονιας
kjv: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

vulg: quod in multo experimento tribulationis abundantia gaudii ipsorum et altissima paupertas eorum abundavit in divitias simplicitatis eorum
clem: quod in multo experimento tribulationis abundantia gaudii ipsorum fuit, et altissima paupertas eorum, abundavit in divitias simplicitatis eorum:
tr: οτι εν πολλη δοκιμη θλιψεως η περισσεια της χαρας αυτων και η κατα βαθους πτωχεια αυτων επερισσευσεν εις τον πλουτον της απλοτητος αυτων
kjv: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

vulg: quia secundum virtutem testimonium illis reddo et supra virtutem voluntarii fuerunt
clem: quia secundum virtutem testimonium illis reddo, et supra virtutem voluntarii fuerunt,
tr: οτι κατα δυναμιν μαρτυρω και υπερ δυναμιν αυθαιρετοι
kjv: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

vulg: cum multa exhortatione obsecrantes nos gratiam et communicationem ministerii quod fit in sanctos
clem: cum multa exhortatione obsecrantes nos gratiam, et communicationem ministerii, quod fit in sanctos.
tr: μετα πολλης παρακλησεως δεομενοι ημων την χαριν και την κοινωνιαν της διακονιας της εις τους αγιους δεξασθαι ημας
kjv: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

vulg: et non sicut speravimus sed semet ipsos dederunt primum Domino deinde nobis per voluntatem Dei
clem: Et non sicut speravimus, sed semetipsos dederunt primum Domino, deinde nobis per voluntatem Dei,
tr: και ου καθως ηλπισαμεν αλλ εαυτους εδωκαν πρωτον τω κυριω και ημιν δια θεληματος θεου
kjv: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

vulg: ita ut rogaremus Titum ut quemadmodum coepit ita et perficiat in vos etiam gratiam istam
clem: ita ut rogaremus Titum, ut quemadmodum cpit, ita et perficiat in vobis etiam gratiam istam.
tr: εις το παρακαλεσαι ημας τιτον ινα καθως προενηρξατο ουτως και επιτελεση εις υμας και την χαριν ταυτην
kjv: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

vulg: sed sicut in omnibus abundatis fide et sermone et scientia et omni sollicitudine et caritate vestra in nos ut et in hac gratia abundetis
clem: Sed sicut in omnibus abundatis fide, et sermone, et scientia, et omni sollicitudine, insuper et caritate vestra in nos, ut et in hac gratia abundetis.
tr: αλλ ωσπερ εν παντι περισσευετε πιστει και λογω και γνωσει και παση σπουδη και τη εξ υμων εν ημιν αγαπη ινα και εν ταυτη τη χαριτι περισσευητε
kjv: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

vulg: non quasi imperans dico sed per aliorum sollicitudinem etiam vestrae caritatis ingenitum bonum conprobans
clem: Non quasi imperans dico: sed per aliorum sollicitudinem, etiam vestr caritatis ingenium bonum comprobans.
tr: ου κατ επιταγην λεγω αλλα δια της ετερων σπουδης και το της υμετερας αγαπης γνησιον δοκιμαζων
kjv: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

vulg: scitis enim gratiam Domini nostri Iesu Christi quoniam propter vos egenus factus est cum esset dives ut illius inopia vos divites essetis
clem: Scitis enim gratiam Domini nostri Jesu Christi, quoniam propter vos egenus factus est, cum esset dives, ut illius inopia vos divites essetis.
tr: γινωσκετε γαρ την χαριν του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου οτι δι υμας επτωχευσεν πλουσιος ων ινα υμεις τη εκεινου πτωχεια πλουτησητε
kjv: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

vulg: et consilium in hoc do hoc enim vobis utile est qui non solum facere sed et velle coepistis ab anno priore
clem: Et consilium in hoc do: hoc enim vobis utile est, qui non solum facere, sed et velle cpistis ab anno priore:
tr: και γνωμην εν τουτω διδωμι τουτο γαρ υμιν συμφερει οιτινες ου μονον το ποιησαι αλλα και το θελειν προενηρξασθε απο περυσι
kjv: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

vulg: nunc vero et facto perficite ut quemadmodum promptus est animus voluntatis ita sit et perficiendi ex eo quod habetis
clem: nunc vero et facto perficite: ut quemadmodum promptus est animus voluntatis, ita sit et perficiendi ex eo quod habetis.
tr: νυνι δε και το ποιησαι επιτελεσατε οπως καθαπερ η προθυμια του θελειν ουτως και το επιτελεσαι εκ του εχειν
kjv: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

vulg: si enim voluntas prompta est secundum id quod habet accepta est non secundum quod non habet
clem: Si enim voluntas prompta est, secundum id quod habet, accepta est, non secundum id quod non habet.
tr: ει γαρ η προθυμια προκειται καθο εαν εχη τις ευπροσδεκτος ου καθο ουκ εχει
kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

vulg: non enim ut aliis sit remissio vobis autem tribulatio sed ex aequalitate
clem: Non enim ut aliis sit remissio, vobis autem tribulatio, sed ex qualitate.
tr: ου γαρ ινα αλλοις ανεσις υμιν δε θλιψις αλλ εξ ισοτητος εν τω νυν καιρω το υμων περισσευμα εις το εκεινων υστερημα
kjv: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

vulg: in praesenti tempore vestra abundantia illorum inopiam suppleat ut et illorum abundantia vestrae inopiae sit supplementum ut fiat aequalitas sicut scriptum est
clem: In prsenti tempore vestra abundantia illorum inopiam suppleat: ut et illorum abundantia vestr inopi sit supplementum, ut fiat qualitas, sicut scriptum est:
tr: ινα και το εκεινων περισσευμα γενηται εις το υμων υστερημα οπως γενηται ισοτης
kjv: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

vulg: qui multum non abundavit et qui modicum non minoravit
clem: Qui multum, non abundavit: et qui modicum, non minoravit.
tr: καθως γεγραπται ο το πολυ ουκ επλεονασεν και ο το ολιγον ουκ ηλαττονησεν
kjv: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

vulg: gratias autem Deo qui dedit eandem sollicitudinem pro vobis in corde Titi
clem: Gratias autem Deo, qui dedit eamdem sollicitudinem pro vobis in corde Titi,
tr: χαρις δε τω θεω τω διδοντι την αυτην σπουδην υπερ υμων εν τη καρδια τιτου
kjv: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

vulg: quoniam exhortationem quidem suscepit sed cum sollicitior esset sua voluntate profectus est ad vos
clem: quoniam exhortationem quidem suscepit: sed cum sollicitior esset, sua voluntate profectus est ad vos.
tr: οτι την μεν παρακλησιν εδεξατο σπουδαιοτερος δε υπαρχων αυθαιρετος εξηλθεν προς υμας
kjv: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

vulg: misimus etiam cum illo fratrem cuius laus est in evangelio per omnes ecclesias
clem: Misimus etiam cum illo fratrem, cujus laus est in Evangelio per omnes ecclesias:
tr: συνεπεμψαμεν δε μετ αυτου τον αδελφον ου ο επαινος εν τω ευαγγελιω δια πασων των εκκλησιων
kjv: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

vulg: non solum autem sed et ordinatus ab ecclesiis comes peregrinationis nostrae in hac gratia quae ministratur a nobis ad Domini gloriam et destinatam voluntatem nostram
clem: non solum autem, sed et ordinatus est ab ecclesiis comes peregrinationis nostr in hanc gratiam, qu ministratur a nobis ad Domini gloriam, et destinatam voluntatem nostram:
tr: ου μονον δε αλλα και χειροτονηθεις υπο των εκκλησιων συνεκδημος ημων συν τη χαριτι ταυτη τη διακονουμενη υφ ημων προς την αυτου του κυριου δοξαν και προθυμιαν υμων
kjv: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

vulg: devitantes hoc ne quis nos vituperet in hac plenitudine quae ministratur a nobis
clem: devitantes hoc, ne quis nos vituperet in hac plenitudine, qu ministratur a nobis.
tr: στελλομενοι τουτο μη τις ημας μωμησηται εν τη αδροτητι ταυτη τη διακονουμενη υφ ημων
kjv: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

vulg: providemus enim bona non solum coram Deo sed etiam coram hominibus
clem: Providemus enim bona non solum coram Deo, sed etiam coram hominibus.
tr: προνοουμενοι καλα ου μονον ενωπιον κυριου αλλα και ενωπιον ανθρωπων
kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

vulg: misimus autem cum illis et fratrem nostrum quem probavimus in multis saepe sollicitum esse nunc autem multo sollicitiorem confidentia multa in vos
clem: Misimus autem cum illis et fratrem nostrum, quem probavimus in multis spe sollicitum esse: nunc autem multo sollicitiorem, confidentia multa in vos,
tr: συνεπεμψαμεν δε αυτοις τον αδελφον ημων ον εδοκιμασαμεν εν πολλοις πολλακις σπουδαιον οντα νυνι δε πολυ σπουδαιοτερον πεποιθησει πολλη τη εις υμας
kjv: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

vulg: sive pro Tito qui est socius meus et in vos adiutor sive fratres nostri apostoli ecclesiarum gloriae Christi
clem: sive pro Tito, qui est socius meus, et in vos adjutor, sive fratres nostri, Apostoli ecclesiarum, gloria Christi.
tr: ειτε υπερ τιτου κοινωνος εμος και εις υμας συνεργος ειτε αδελφοι ημων αποστολοι εκκλησιων δοξα χριστου
kjv: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

vulg: ostensionem ergo quae est caritatis vestrae et nostrae gloriae pro vobis in illos ostendite in faciem ecclesiarum
clem: Ostensionem ergo, qu est caritatis vestr, et nostr glori pro vobis, in illos ostendite in faciem ecclesiarum.
tr: την ουν ενδειξιν της αγαπης υμων και ημων καυχησεως υπερ υμων εις αυτους ενδειξασθε και εις προσωπον των εκκλησιων
kjv: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

vulg: nam de ministerio quod fit in sanctos ex abundanti est mihi scribere vobis
clem: Nam de ministerio, quod fit in sanctos ex abundanti est mihi scribere vobis.
tr: περι μεν γαρ της διακονιας της εις τους αγιους περισσον μοι εστιν το γραφειν υμιν
kjv: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

vulg: scio enim promptum animum vestrum pro quo de vobis glorior apud Macedonas quoniam Achaia parata est ab anno praeterito et vestra aemulatio provocavit plurimos
clem: Scio enim promptum animum vestrum: pro quo de vobis glorior apud Macedones. Quoniam et Achaia parata est ab anno prterito, et vestra mulatio provocavit plurimos.
tr: οιδα γαρ την προθυμιαν υμων ην υπερ υμων καυχωμαι μακεδοσιν οτι αχαια παρεσκευασται απο περυσι και ο εξ υμων ζηλος ηρεθισεν τους πλειονας
kjv: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

vulg: misi autem fratres ut ne quod gloriamur de vobis evacuetur in hac parte ut quemadmodum dixi parati sitis
clem: Misi autem fratres: ut ne quod gloriamur de vobis, evacuetur in hac parte, ut (quemadmodum dixi) parati sitis:
tr: επεμψα δε τους αδελφους ινα μη το καυχημα ημων το υπερ υμων κενωθη εν τω μερει τουτω ινα καθως ελεγον παρεσκευασμενοι ητε
kjv: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

vulg: ne cum venerint mecum Macedones et invenerint vos inparatos erubescamus nos ut non dicamus vos in hac substantia
clem: ne cum venerint Macedones mecum, et invenerint vos imparatos, erubescamus nos (ut non dicamus vos) in hac substantia.
tr: μηπως εαν ελθωσιν συν εμοι μακεδονες και ευρωσιν υμας απαρασκευαστους καταισχυνθωμεν ημεις ινα μη λεγωμεν υμεις εν τη υποστασει ταυτη της καυχησεως
kjv: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

vulg: necessarium ergo existimavi rogare fratres ut praeveniant ad vos et praeparent repromissam benedictionem hanc paratam esse sic quasi benedictionem non quasi avaritiam
clem: Necessarium ergo existimavi rogare fratres, ut prveniant ad vos, et prparent repromissam benedictionem hanc paratam esse sic, quasi benedictionem, non tamquam avaritiam.
tr: αναγκαιον ουν ηγησαμην παρακαλεσαι τους αδελφους ινα προελθωσιν εις υμας και προκαταρτισωσιν την προκατηγγελμενην ευλογιαν υμων ταυτην ετοιμην ειναι ουτως ως ευλογιαν και μη ωσπερ πλεονεξιαν
kjv: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

vulg: hoc autem qui parce seminat parce et metet et qui seminat in benedictionibus de benedictionibus et metet
clem: Hoc autem dico: qui parce seminat, parce et metet: et qui seminat in benedictionibus, de benedictionibus et metet.
tr: τουτο δε ο σπειρων φειδομενως φειδομενως και θερισει και ο σπειρων επ ευλογιαις επ ευλογιαις και θερισει
kjv: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

vulg: unusquisque prout destinavit corde suo non ex tristitia aut ex necessitate hilarem enim datorem diligit Deus
clem: Unusquisque, prout destinavit in corde suo, non ex tristitia, aut ex necessitate: hilarem enim datorem diligit Deus.
tr: εκαστος καθως προαιρειται τη καρδια μη εκ λυπης η εξ αναγκης ιλαρον γαρ δοτην αγαπα ο θεος
kjv: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

vulg: potens est autem Deus omnem gratiam abundare facere in vobis ut in omnibus semper omnem sufficientiam habentes abundetis in omne opus bonum
clem: Potens est autem Deus omnem gratiam abundare facere in vobis: ut in omnibus semper omnem sufficientiam habentes, abundetis in omne opus bonum,
tr: δυνατος δε ο θεος πασαν χαριν περισσευσαι εις υμας ινα εν παντι παντοτε πασαν αυταρκειαν εχοντες περισσευητε εις παν εργον αγαθον
kjv: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

vulg: sicut scriptum est dispersit dedit pauperibus iustitia eius manet in aeternum
clem: sicut scriptum est: Dispersit, dedit pauperibus: justitia ejus manet in sculum sculi.
tr: καθως γεγραπται εσκορπισεν εδωκεν τοις πενησιν η δικαιοσυνη αυτου μενει εις τον αιωνα
kjv: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

vulg: qui autem administrat semen seminanti et panem ad manducandum praestabit et multiplicabit semen vestrum et augebit incrementa frugum iustitiae vestrae
clem: Qui autem administrat semen seminanti: et panem ad manducandum prstabit, et multiplicabit semen vestrum, et augebit incrementa frugum justiti vestr:
tr: ο δε επιχορηγων σπερμα τω σπειροντι και αρτον εις βρωσιν χορηγησαι και πληθυναι τον σπορον υμων και αυξησαι τα γεννηματα της δικαιοσυνης υμων
kjv: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

vulg: ut in omnibus locupletati abundetis in omnem simplicitatem quae operatur per nos gratiarum actionem Deo
clem: ut in omnibus locupletati abundetis in omnem simplicitatem, qu operatur per nos gratiarum actionem Deo.
tr: εν παντι πλουτιζομενοι εις πασαν απλοτητα ητις κατεργαζεται δι ημων ευχαριστιαν τω θεω
kjv: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

vulg: quoniam ministerium huius officii non solum supplet ea quae desunt sanctis sed etiam abundat per multas gratiarum actiones in Domino
clem: Quoniam ministerium hujus officii non solum supplet ea qu desunt sanctis, sed etiam abundat per multas gratiarum actiones in Domino,
tr: οτι η διακονια της λειτουργιας ταυτης ου μονον εστιν προσαναπληρουσα τα υστερηματα των αγιων αλλα και περισσευουσα δια πολλων ευχαριστιων τω θεω
kjv: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

vulg: per probationem ministerii huius glorificantes Deum in oboedientia confessionis vestrae in evangelium Christi et simplicitate communicationis in illos et in omnes
clem: per probationem ministerii hujus, glorificantes Deum in obedientia confessionis vestr, in Evangelium Christi, et simplicitate communicationis in illos, et in omnes,
tr: δια της δοκιμης της διακονιας ταυτης δοξαζοντες τον θεον επι τη υποταγη της ομολογιας υμων εις το ευαγγελιον του χριστου και απλοτητι της κοινωνιας εις αυτους και εις παντας
kjv: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

vulg: et ipsorum obsecratione pro vobis desiderantium vos propter eminentem gratiam Dei in vobis
clem: et in ipsorum obsecratione pro vobis, desiderantium vos propter eminentem gratiam Dei in vobis.
tr: και αυτων δεησει υπερ υμων επιποθουντων υμας δια την υπερβαλλουσαν χαριν του θεου εφ υμιν
